arguments.assumptions: FY2027 is NVIDIA's disclosed 53-week fiscal year. Reported GAAP diluted EPS is $4.85 for the first 26 weeks ended 2026-07-26, using the reported diluted-share basis; grid assumes a constant split-adjusted share basis solely for sensitivity. Annual EPS cases are analyst assumptions, not consensus: bear $8.50 (remaining 27-week EPS $3.65, reflecting demand/order normalization and/or margin pressure); base $9.50 (remaining $4.65, supported by Q3 revenue guidance of $108bn +/-2%, but no Q4 guidance); bull $10.50 (remaining $5.65, requiring continued data-center demand and execution beyond the disclosed Q3 outlook). Multiples 18x/24x/30x are hypothetical stress inputs, not observed, fair, normal, or probable multiples.

cases.rationale: Hypothetical miss: $3.65 residual GAAP EPS is below the trajectory implied by the reported first-half $4.85, if AI infrastructure demand normalizes, supply/China constraints impede revenue, or margins compress.
Hypothetical continuation: $4.65 residual GAAP EPS assumes Q3 revenue near the disclosed $108bn +/-2% outlook and a reasonably profitable Q4 despite no Q4 guide.
Hypothetical beat: $5.65 residual GAAP EPS assumes data-center demand and execution remain strong through the un-guided Q4, with no material margin deterioration.
